0.long_answer: The medication is deferasirox. It is an iron chelator used to manage iron overload associated with conditions such as thalassemia major. Originally, the European Medicines Agency approved deferasirox (marketed as Exjade) for chronic iron overload treatment, and 12 years later the FDA approved its use (marketed under the brand name Jadenu) to treat thalassemia major. In addition to its application in thalassemia, deferasirox is also used to treat hemochromatosis by binding excess iron and helping remove it from the body.
